story_candidates.title: Loulé agency 3WX launches Best Number One, a free start page
story_candidates.angle: A Loulé digital agency, 3WX, says it presented Best Number One, a free start page for organising favourite links, at Web Summit 2026 on 12 November, and that it passed 300 sign-ups in the first hours. What the platform does, in its own words, and who says what: the figures and the launch claim come from the company, relayed by two regional papers.
story_candidates.note: For journalist-portugal (Vicky's urgent request, standing answer 76). Ready. Conditions: re-read the three pages yourself; the two newspapers count as one source (same quote, same company wording); attribute the 300 sign-ups and the launch at Web Summit to the company, as the reports give them (3WX says, according to Postal do Algarve), never as fact; the platform's description is from its own page; no founder's name, no contact details; no Web Summit page cited (link to Web Summit's own pages only if needed, do not copy); no claim that it is a startup or an exhibitor; short and plain (STYLE.md); categories Web Summit 2026 and Portugal (Startups & Scaleups is not supported by the sources).

for_the_fact_checker.what: The 300 sign-ups and the presentation at Web Summit 2026 come from the company through two papers drawn from one wording; no independent report or count was found. The platform's own page counts its links (642 selected sites): do not present that as users.

gaps_for_the_researcher.gap: Any independent report or Web Summit-side acknowledgement of the presentation (press or the organisers' own posts, not websummit.com by machine); 3WX's own page on the launch.
gaps_for_the_researcher.reader_angle: Whether the launch is confirmed beyond the company.
gaps_for_the_researcher.why_not_a_duplicate: Only the company's wording, twice, and its own page are captured.
